data.gender_notes: Niks is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niksha', meaning 'to conquer' or 'to be victorious'. This name is a symbol of strength, courage, and the determination to overcome obstacles. The name Niks carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Niks usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hindu mythology, 'Niks' is the name of a powerful deity associated with the sun and victory. It represents the power of the sun to illuminate and conquer darkness, and the courage and strength needed to overcome challenges in life.
data.etymology: Niks belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niks total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
